title: Native registries fail to reject their exact capacity boundary
summary: `indigo_libs/indigo_client.c:209`, `:400` and `:530` test `empty_slot > INDIGO_MAX_DRIVERS/SERVERS`. Arrays are declared with exactly those capacities (`:75`, `:313`, `:441`; public header defines256 drivers and10 servers). With no reusable slot, empty_slot equals the used count, so the257th distinct driver or11th live remote server/subprocess bypasses the intended TOO_MANY_ELEMENTS return and indexes the element after the registry. This is an ordinary full-capacity contract mismatch; no capacity stress or malicious-input run was performed.
